provenance: Project-authored overlay for the supplied manufacturing pack. Personas are archetypes, not named people. Synergy factors and signal readings are synthetic and unvalidated.

personas.title: Plant Director
personas.archetype: Accountable for throughput and plant P&L
personas.quote: We lose a shift a week to stops nobody logs. I need that visible and owned.
pains: OEE reported weekly, too late to act

personas.title: Production Shift Manager
personas.archetype: Runs the line hour by hour
personas.quote: Micro-stops do not trigger an alarm. They just eat the shift.

personas.title: Quality Engineer
personas.archetype: Owns scrap, rework and process capability
personas.quote: Scrap spikes after restarts. I can see it, I cannot prove it yet.
pains: Quality data separate from stop data

personas.title: Reliability Engineer
personas.archetype: Turns condition data into maintenance strategy
personas.quote: Vibration alerts are rising and the backlog is rising. Which asset first?
pains: Backlog ranked by age, not risk

personas.title: Maintenance Planner
personas.archetype: Schedules work into permitted change windows
personas.quote: I can fit two jobs into Sunday's window. Tell me which two matter most.

personas.title: Energy & EHS Manager
personas.archetype: Reports energy intensity and safety performance
personas.quote: Energy per good unit falls whenever uptime rises. I must not claim both.

personas.title: OT Security Architect
personas.quote: Read-only from the historian, through the DMZ. Nothing writes to a PLC.

personas.title: Plant Controller
personas.quote: Show me the benefit once. Uptime, energy and maintenance all claim the same hours.

synergies.title: Predict, then prevent micro-stops
synergies.mechanism: Condition alerts on constraint assets often precede clusters of micro-stops. Ranking the maintenance backlog by constraint impact targets the stops that cost throughput.
synergies.extendedOutcome: Throughput recovered at the constraint, with maintenance effort aimed where it moves OEE.

synergies.title: Throughput-normalised energy
synergies.mechanism: Energy per good unit falls automatically when uptime rises. Most of the apparent energy gain is the uptime gain counted twice.
synergies.extendedOutcome: An honest energy-intensity claim: only the improvement beyond the uptime effect is counted as energy value.
evidenceNeeded: Regression of energy on good units

synergies.title: Reliability-led plant performance
synergies.mechanism: Stops, energy and condition data share the same historian and CMMS. One review cycle ranks every intervention by net, de-duplicated value.
synergies.extendedOutcome: One plant performance ledger where uptime, energy and maintenance benefits are recognised once.
